## iSpotify 19.4.3

This release was prepared automatically after [PR #0](https://github.com) passed the protected test suite and merged.

### Changes

- Manual stable release

### Downloads

- Windows installer: `ISpotify-Setup-x86_64.exe`
- Windows portable: `ISpotify-windows-x86_64.exe`
- Linux portable: `ISpotify-linux-x86_64`
- Debian/Ubuntu: `ispotify_19.4.3_amd64.deb`

The release is published only after both platform builds succeed.
